Chapter Seven: When the System Itself Breaks Down—And Becomes a Burden on Its Own People.
Picture this: the storm outside just keeps raging on, but now, the real trouble is brewing inside. The very system that once promised safety? It’s starting to crack under pressure.
Suddenly, even the people working inside don’t feel safe anymore. They’re not just watching others—they’re becoming targets themselves. One day, someone gets called in for questioning. Why? Just because they made a phone call to a relative in another city. There’s no real reason. But in this world, suspicion is all it takes to set things in motion.
Imagine how it feels. The place that used to feel like a fortress... now it’s just a heavy weight on your back. There’s no clear line between who’s watching and who’s being watched. Everyone’s trapped in this system of constant doubt.
At a meeting, someone notices the boss acting tougher than ever before. It’s like he’s so afraid of losing control, he starts cracking down on everything and everyone.
The pressure? It’s getting to everyone. Suddenly, sleepless nights and constant anxiety become the new normal. Picture a worker lying awake at night, replaying every conversation, every word—afraid that one small mistake could change everything. That fear of slipping up? It’s bigger than ever, and everyone’s living on edge.
Even friendships start to fall apart. One day, someone discovers that their closest friend secretly wrote a report about them. Maybe there aren’t any serious accusations, but honestly, that’s not the point. The damage is done. In that moment, trust just disappears. Suddenly, it feels like every relationship could fall apart at any second.
As the pressure builds, some people start thinking about running away or quitting. But leaving isn’t easy. There’s always the threat of revenge or losing the little sense of security they have left.
In one story, a worker tries to resign, hoping for a fresh start. But instead, they get a veiled threat—“Leaving isn’t really an option.” That’s when it hits them: the system isn’t just a job. It’s a prison. And escaping? Not so simple.
Still, even in the darkest moments, a few people hold onto their humanity. One night, someone takes a risk, helping a family that’s been wronged—even though it puts them in danger. For a moment, they feel like themselves again. Like they still have a choice, even when it feels impossible.
So, as the pressure and the cracks keep piling up, it becomes painfully clear: this security system isn’t just about controlling society. It’s a heavy burden on the very people inside it, too. Everyone’s caught in this endless cycle of fear and suspicion, searching for a way out that never seems close.
